description: Three open PRs, none reviewed yet, at different ages. Confirms review-wait correctly EXCLUDES PRs with zero reviews (n=0 -> insufficient_data) rather than treating an unreviewed PR as a very-large wait time. Also confirms pending-review count is a point-in-time snapshot independent of creation window (PR_403 was created before the current window but still counts as pending today). Only 2 of the 3 are stale (>=5 days), below the 3-PR minimum, so STALE_PULL_REQUESTS does not fire.

pull_requests.author: alice
pull_requests.note: idle 2.0 days -- not stale, created inside current window, zero reviews

pull_requests.author: bob
pull_requests.note: idle 6.0 days -- stale, created inside current window, zero reviews, one outstanding review request

pull_requests.author: carol
pull_requests.note: idle 10.0 days -- stale, created in the baseline window but still open today (point-in-time pending count includes it regardless)

expected.findings_rationale: REVIEW_BOTTLENECK cannot evaluate (review-wait sample is n=0 in both windows). STALE_PULL_REQUESTS does not fire: only 2 PRs cross the 5-day threshold, one short of the 3-PR minimum. review_concentration is insufficient_data because only 1 pending PR has an outstanding request, below the 3-PR minimum for that metric.
